Require the real phase summary, independent full durable terminal, original actual assigned nonce, exact result bytes and SHA before generating any request.
Accept terminal succeeded/0 or failed/1 only when summary ok agrees; keep original failure and outcome_unknown fields.
Read only result.json twice with the original complete-content hash, NOFOLLOW walk, final held/named identity, and FD finalization function.

Collection is not a test, cleanup, UID or runtime qualification.
ownership_boundary: The original reader pins the exact file body and final held/named file identity. It does not newly claim all shared ancestor names remain unchanged throughout the read.
allowed_storage: Unreferenced immutable Git source package only; Root is sole dispatcher.
